verdict.rationale: The Brave Search API is a documented public REST API. Its docs cover API-key onboarding, concrete curl endpoints such as /res/v1/local/descriptions, per-endpoint API reference pages (rich search, POIs, suggestions, spellcheck), and AI-oriented endpoints like LLM Context and an OpenAI-SDK-compatible Answers service. A live llms.txt aids agent consumption. Community notes say the free-tier ToS bars AI inference, but a separate AI Inference plan is available, so this is a licensing caveat rather than a gap in the API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
